speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; can you tell me exactly when these symptoms started and if you are currently in your third trimester of pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

I have noted the onset of fever, headache, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation following ice cream consumption; this history strongly suggests Listeria. I will now request the specific laboratory results to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Serum_CRP, and Maternal_WBC_Count.
